name: DeepInfra serverless inference
price_basis: USD per 1M TOKENS, representative model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.1, observed 2026-10-14 ($0.25 in / $0.13 cached / $0.95 out, 160k ctx). DeepInfra is the LOW end of this record set on most shared models: the same-day OpenRouter table shows its Turbo tier serving llama-3.3-70b at $0.10/$0.32 - the cheapest row there - and its own page has Qwen3-235B at $0.09/$0.55, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 at $0.06/$0.18. Some models bill per inference-execution second instead of per token; the token-priced subset is what the per-mtok fields describe. Account cap: 200 concurrent requests.
notes: Measured figures are the OpenRouter 2026-10-14 P50 for DeepInfra (Turbo) on llama-3.3-70b-instruct: 0.51s latency, 14 tok/s, 99.52% uptime - the cheapest and the SLOWEST row on that table, which is exactly the price-vs-speed trade this record type exists to expose. 14 tps is shared-infrastructure Turbo, not a dedicated deployment. DeepInfra's own page states all models run on H100 or A100 GPUs. Two tiers appear on provider tables: standard and Turbo (cheaper, sometimes FP8); Artificial Analysis benchmarks them separately.
